query_definitions.Q3_concrete_union: SELECT cache_table,cache_rowid,raw_record_id,CAST(cache.generation AS TEXT) AS generation FROM selected_links JOIN allowlisted_cache_table cache ON cache.rowid=cache_rowid WHERE cache.generation IS NOT NULL AND CAST(cache.generation AS TEXT) NOT IN ('','UNKNOWN_LEGACY','GENERATION_MISSING'); -- union evidence_records,tclk_frames,kibble_events; messages/opportunities have no generation; validation_response_candidates had no selected links
query_definitions.Q4_sets: SELECT raw_record_id,COUNT(*) AS concrete_links,COUNT(DISTINCT generation) AS distinct_generations FROM concrete_union GROUP BY raw_record_id; -- explicit sorted sets computed per identity; never emit identities
query_definitions.Q5_alternatives: SELECT a.* FROM affected_raws r JOIN raw_network_records a INDEXED BY raw_room_sequence ON a.room=r.room AND a.seq=r.seq AND a.raw_text_sha256=r.raw_text_sha256 WHERE a.raw_record_id<>r.raw_record_id; -- full source, all generations/sources, no LIMIT
query_definitions.Q6_retrievals: SELECT x.* FROM evidence_retrievals x JOIN unknown_raws r ON x.raw_record_id=r.raw_record_id; -- inspect generation claims in body_generation/header_generation/headers if present
query_definitions.Q7_pair_checks: For each selected cache row fetch by its PK; exact room/seq; SHA256 of exact UTF-8 raw and cache text; stored link/hash equality; sender aliases; decimal nonce string without float; exact signature; network timestamps and capture timestamps separately. Compare availability before equality. Exact cache timestamps agree wherever represented; no normalization-based equality needed. TCLK observed_at is capture time, not network time. Source container label differs from original endpoint lineage.
query_definitions.Q8_identity_authenticity: Recompute raw_identity(source,room,actual_generation,reported_generation,parsed_raw_record_json), exact UTF-8 hash and envelope-text hash. Independently run verify_signed_record_offline(room,raw) using public DID material only. Correlate cache statuses. Signature equality is not signature validity. Full provenance also requires original endpoint/source-epoch and authoritative generation capture; no affected record meets that requirement.
query_definitions.Q9_joint: Accumulate complete check-result vectors per (cache_table,generation), plus named predicates on each SAME row, not products/minima of marginal counts. Missing is UNAVAILABLE_RAW/LINK/BOTH or UNKNOWN lineage, never AGREE.
